01

“By the mount”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 52:1).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
By the mount [al-Tur 1] he said: "The tur is the mountain, in Syriac."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَالطُّورِ [الطور: 1] قَالَ: " الطُّورُ: الْجَبَلُ بِالسُّرْيَانِيَّةِ "
Edition record 373451 · p. 622Link to report ↗
02

“and a book inscribed”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 52:2).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and a book inscribed [al-Tur 2] meaning: "written scrolls."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَكِتَابٍ مَسْطُورٍ [الطور: 2] ، يَعْنِي: «صُحُفًا مَكْتُوبَةً»
Edition record 373452 · p. 622Link to report ↗
03

“in parchment spread open”

Four explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr, Anas ibn Mālik, ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ and ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib (Q 52:3).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
in parchment spread open [al-Tur 3] meaning: "in sheets."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
فِي رَقٍّ مَنْشُورٍ [الطور: 3] ، يَعْنِي: «فِي صُحُفٍ»
Edition record 373453 · p. 622Link to report ↗
04
Report from Anas ibn Mālik 04

Anas ibn Mālik

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, saying: Thabit al-Bunani related to us, from Anas ibn Malik, who said:
The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "The Frequented House is in the seventh heaven; seventy thousand angels enter it every day, and then do not return to it until the Hour is established."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ:
«الْبَيْتُ الْمَعْمُورُ فِي السَّمَاءِ السَّابِعَةِ يَدْخُلُهُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ، ثُمَّ لَا يَعُودُونَ إِلَيْهِ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ»
Edition record 373454 · p. 622Link to report ↗
05
Report from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr 05

ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr ibn al-ʿĀṣ

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Shayban related to us, saying: Qatada related to us, from Salim ibn Abi al-Jad, from Maadan ibn Talha, from Abd God ibn Amr ibn al-As, who said:
"The Frequented House is a house in the sky directly above the Kaba; were it to fall, it would fall upon it. Seventy ⦗p. 623⦘ thousand angels pray in it every day, and the Haram is a sanctuary directly beneath it up to the Throne, and there is no spot in the sky the size of a hide that does not have an angel prostrating or standing upon it."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا شَيْبَانُ، قَالَ: نا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، قَالَ:
«الْبَيْتُ الْمَعْمُورُ بَيْتٌ فِي السَّمَاءِ بِحِيَالِ الْكَعْبَةِ لَوْ سَقَطَ سَقَطَ عَلَيْهَا، يُصَلِّي فِيهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ سَبْعُونَ ⦗ص: 623⦘ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ، وَالْحَرَمُ حَرَمٌ بِحِيَالِهِ إِلَى الْعَرْشِ، وَمَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَوْضِعُ إِهَابٍ إِلَّا وَعَلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ سَاجِدٌ أَوْ قَائِمٌ»
Edition record 373455 · p. 622Link to report ↗
06
Report from ʿAlī 06

ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Simak ibn Harb, from Khalid ibn Arara, from Ali ibn Abi Talib ؓ who said:
"The raised ceiling is the sky."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَرْعَرَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه، قَالَ: السَّقْفُ الْمَرْفُوعُ
«السَّمَاءُ»
Edition record 373456 · p. 623Link to report ↗
04

“and the sea set aflame”

Three explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr, al-Ḥasan and Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab (Q 52:6).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and the sea set aflame [al-Tur 6] he said: "meaning kindled."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ [الطور: 6] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي الْمُوقَدَ»
Edition record 373457 · p. 623Link to report ↗
08
Report from al-Ḥasan 08

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan, who said:
"It will be set aflame until its water is gone and not a drop remains in it."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
«تُسْجَرُ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ مَاؤُهَا فَلَا يَبْقَى فِيهَا قَطْرَةٌ»
Edition record 373458 · p. 623Link to report ↗
09
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab 09

Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Dawud ibn Abi Hind, from Said ibn al-Musayyab, who said:
Ali ibn Abi Talib ﷺ said to a Jew: "Where is Hell?" The Jew said: "Beneath the sea." Ali said: "He spoke the truth," then recited: and the sea set aflame [al-Tur 6].
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، قَالَ: قَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عليه السلام لِلْيَهُودِيِّ: أَيْنَ جَهَنَّمُ؟
" فَقَالَ الْيَهُوَدِيُّ: تَحْتَ الْبَحْرِ، قَالَ عَلِيٌّ: «صَدَقَ» ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ: وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ [الطور: 6]
Edition record 373459 · p. 623Link to report ↗
05

“The Day they will be thrust into the fire of Hell with a [violent]…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 52:13).

10
Explanation from Mujāhid 10

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
The Day they will be thrust into the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust [al-Tur 13] he said: "they will be pushed into it with a push."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعَّا [الطور: 13] قَالَ: «يُدْفَعُونَ إِلَيْهَا دَفْعًا»
Edition record 373460 · p. 623Link to report ↗
06

“and We will not deprive them”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 52:21).

11
Explanation from Mujāhid 11

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and We will not deprive them [al-Tur 21] He says: "We will not reduce anything of the fathers for the sake of the sons."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَمَا أَلَتْنَاهُمْ [الطور: 21] يَقُولُ: «مَا نَقَصْنَا الْآبَاءَ لِلْأَبْنَاءِ شَيْئًا»
Edition record 373461 · p. 624Link to report ↗
07

“nor any sinful speech”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 52:23).

12
Explanation from Mujāhid 12

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, he said:
"Laghw is abuse; He says: they will not abuse one another"; nor any sinful speech [al-Tur 23] He says: "they will not sin and will not be made to sin."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" اللَّغْوُ السَّبُّ، يَقُولُ: لَا يَسْتَبُّونَ "، وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ [الطور: 23] يَقُولُ: «لَا يَأْثَمُونَ وَلَا يُؤْثِمُونَ»
Edition record 373462 · p. 624Link to report ↗
